li.label: silk thread body
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was born with a soul that frays at the edges, like silk pulled from a cocoon. In the Thousand Strings Valley that is not a flaw: each loose strand is a thread waiting for a puppet.

li.label: steel thread body
li.description: The threads of {PAWN_nameDef}'s soul have been drawn and tempered like steel wire. {PAWN_pronoun} can feel a puppet's footsteps through the floor, and the puppet can feel {PAWN_possessive} intent before the hand moves.

li.label: jade thread body
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s soul threads have turned to jade: cool, unbreakable, almost visible in the right light. The Valley says that a jade-threaded master can split attention like Yan Shi, whose automaton bowed to a king while its maker stood still.

li.label: heart of a thousand threads
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s heart has become a spindle with a thousand threads wound around it. Only the Valley's grand masters ever reached it; they say the master stops feeling where the body ends and the puppets begin, and that this is the point.
